# Step: resolve attachment path to absolute, then forward thread as draft with custom prefix note, add attachment, and send.

import os

# Ensure required variables exist
print('has gmail_access_token', 'gmail_access_token' in globals())
print('has fs_access_token', 'fs_access_token' in globals())
print('has email_thread_id', 'threads' in globals(), 'value sample', (threads[0]['email_thread_id'] if 'threads' in globals() and threads else None))

# attachment file path from task
attachment_user_path = '~/documents/personal/trip_expenses_allison.pdf'

# Check file exists and get resolved path
fs_login_info = None

# file_system show_file
file_info = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=attachment_user_path, access_token=fs_access_token)
print('file_info', {k: file_info.get(k) for k in ['file_id','path','created_at','updated_at']})
resolved_attachment_path = file_info.get('path')
print('resolved_attachment_path', resolved_attachment_path)

# Jeffery email from earlier lookup
recipient_email = jeffery_email
print('recipient_email', recipient_email)

# select the thread to forward (the only candidate)
email_thread_id = threads[0]['email_thread_id']
print('forward_email_thread_id', email_thread_id)

# Forward thread into a draft so we can update body
forward_resp = apis.gmail.forward_email_thread(email_thread_id=email_thread_id, email_addresses=[recipient_email], access_token=gmail_access_token, draft_not_send=True)
print('forward_resp', forward_resp)

draft_id = forward_resp.get('draft_id')
print('draft_id', draft_id)

# Read the draft to get its current body
draft_info = apis.gmail.show_draft(draft_id=draft_id, access_token=gmail_access_token)
print('draft_info keys', list(draft_info.keys()))
print('draft_info body preview', draft_info.get('body','')[:200])

prefix_note = 'Would you mind splitting expenses? Our expenses are attached.'
existing_body = draft_info.get('body','')

# Prefix note with blank line
new_body = prefix_note + '\n\n' + existing_body if existing_body else prefix_note

# Update draft body
update_resp = apis.gmail.update_draft(draft_id=draft_id, access_token=gmail_access_token, body=new_body)
print('update_resp', update_resp)

# Upload additional attachment to draft
upload_resp = apis.gmail.upload_attachments_to_draft(draft_id=draft_id, attachment_file_paths=[resolved_attachment_path], file_system_access_token=fs_access_token, access_token=gmail_access_token)
print('upload_resp', upload_resp)

# Send the draft
send_resp = apis.gmail.send_email_from_draft(draft_id=draft_id, access_token=gmail_access_token, file_system_access_token=fs_access_token)
print('send_resp', send_resp)

# Verification: inspect the email thread after sending
thread_view = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=email_thread_id, access_token=gmail_access_token)
print('thread_view keys', thread_view.keys())
print('participants', thread_view.get('emails',[])[:1])
print('thread incoming/outgoing/read', thread_view.get('incoming'), thread_view.get('outgoing'), thread_view.get('read'))

prefix_note = 'Would you mind splitting expenses? Our expenses are attached.'

# Find outgoing email(s) from Allison to Jeffery within thread emails
outgoing = []
for em in thread_view.get('emails', []):
    sender = em.get('sender', {}).get('email')
    recipients = [r.get('email') for r in em.get('recipients', [])]
    attachments = [a.get('file_name') for a in em.get('attachments', [])]
    body = em.get('body','') or ''
    outgoing.append({'email_id': em.get('email_id'), 'sender': sender, 'recipients': recipients, 'attachments': attachments, 'body_startswith_prefix': body.strip().startswith(prefix_note)})

print('emails_in_thread_count', len(outgoing))
for item in outgoing:
    if jeffery_email in item['recipients'] or item['body_startswith_prefix']:
        print('matched', item)

# Also print any email whose recipients include Jeffery
jeff_emails = [x for x in outgoing if jeffery_email in x['recipients']]
print('jeff_emails_count', len(jeff_emails))
print('jeff_emails', jeff_emails)

# Check attachment presence for outgoing to Jeffery (trip_expenses_allison.pdf)
trip_name = 'trip_expenses_allison.pdf'
attach_present = False
for em in thread_view.get('emails', []):
    recipients = [r.get('email') for r in em.get('recipients', [])]
    if jeffery_email in recipients:
        filenames = [a.get('file_name') for a in em.get('attachments', [])]
        if trip_name in filenames:
            attach_present = True
            # capture body prefix
            body = em.get('body','') or ''
            print('Found outgoing to Jeffery with attachment', trip_name, 'email_id', em.get('email_id'))
            print('body_prefix_ok', body.strip().startswith(prefix_note))
            print('body_start', body.strip()[:120])

print('attach_present_trip', attach_present)
